H_protocol: H1 literal own-plane act; H2 amplified actual disposition/reaction. No selected whole premise warrants primary H3 (actual behavior-dependent local punchline commitment) or H4 (whole-unit nonliteral license). Deliberate staging, imagined romance, reported fantasy mechanics, a meta-story phrase, nested idiom and magical transformation do not themselves warrant either. No quota.
L_protocol: L0 portable content; L1 material wording/timing; L2 material register/pragmatics; L3 central Japanese form needing reconstruction/annotation. The ボッチンピラ blend warrants L3. Written child speech, pronoun shifts and rhetorical formulas are argued individually, not automatically L3.
